stem: In which quotation does the author use descriptive language to show her unexpected awe?

options.label: F
options.text: I crawled out of my tent and stood slowly, my muscles stiff from yesterday's hike, my bare feet tender on the rocky dirt.

options.label: G
options.text: My pack's frame creaked behind me with each step, straining from the weight. The muscles of my upper back and shoulders were bound in tense, hot knots.

options.label: H
options.text: I knew it was the top because there was snow. Not on the ground, but falling from the sky, in thin flakes that swirled in mad patterns, pushed by the wind.

options.label: J
options.text: By noon I was up over 6,000 feet and the air had cooled, the sun suddenly disappearing behind clouds.
